notes.title: Update and Achievements
notes.content:
Hello Guys
We have news about the game
A few days ago we added an interactive part in the second chapter of the game, the protagonist can walk freely in Ori Asylum and interact with various environments
We also added Achievements and Mac / Linux version
See you soon with important news about Soundtrack

notes.title: Game release officially set
notes.content:
Hi Guys
We had a bit of difficulty setting up the build but now we are practically ready for the official launch of the game, Bios Ex will be release on April 17th, maybe there are some delays for the achievements ... I wish you a good experience at our game that after 3 years of hard development is finally about to be completed
